lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How was your solo trip to Portugal? Was it everything you hoped for?
lines.ko: 포르투갈 혼자 다녀온 여행은 어땠어? 기대했던 만큼 좋았어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It was incredible! I completely stepped out of my comfort zone and tried surfing for the first time.
lines.ko: 진짜 최고였어! 익숙한 틀에서 완전히 벗어나서 난생처음 서핑도 배워봤잖아.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Wow, surfing? Weren't you terrified of the huge waves?
lines.ko: 와, 서핑을? 큰 파도가 무섭지는 않았어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: At first, yes, but catching that first wave gave me such a huge rush.
lines.ko: 처음엔 겁났는데, 첫 파도를 딱 타는 순간 엄청난 전율이 느껴지더라고.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That sounds exhilarating. Did you get a chance to connect with any locals?
lines.ko: 정말 짜릿했겠다. 현지인들과 어울릴 기회도 있었어?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Definitely. I took a cooking workshop and ended up sharing dinner with a local family.
lines.ko: 그럼, 당연하지. 쿠킹 클래스를 들었는데, 결국 현지인 가족이랑 같이 저녁까지 먹게 됐어.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: That must have been an unforgettable memory.
lines.ko: 정말 평생 잊지 못할 추억이 됐겠다.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It really was. It totally changed my perspective on traveling alone.
lines.ko: 정말 그랬어. 혼자 여행하는 것에 대한 내 생각을 완전히 바꿔놓았어.

expressions.en: step out of one's comfort zone
expressions.example: Traveling to a foreign country forces you to step out of your comfort zone.
expressions.exampleKo: 외국으로 여행을 떠나면 익숙하고 편한 영역에서 벗어날 수밖에 없다.

expressions.example: Bungee jumping was scary, but it gave me an incredible rush.
expressions.exampleKo: 번지점프는 무서웠지만 정말 엄청난 짜릿함을 주었다.

expressions.example: We missed the last bus and ended up walking back to the hotel.
expressions.exampleKo: 막차를 놓쳐서 결국 호텔까지 걸어가게 되었다.

expressions.example: Meeting people from different cultures completely changed my perspective on life.
expressions.exampleKo: 다양한 문화권의 사람들을 만나면서 삶에 대한 내 시각이 완전히 바뀌었다.
